Determine the rate of heat flow through the boiler wall made of 2 cm thick steel and covered with an insulating material of 0.5 cm thick.

K(insulation) = 0.116 w/mk.

misprint.doubt: The wall area is not given in the question.
misprint.assumption: Area A = 1 m² is assumed, so the answer is the heat flow per square metre of wall. For any other area, multiply by that area.
